evidence.claim: The visible atlas failures have complete two-chunk pointer chains, while the existing pointer-first packing still led the frozen reader to abstain; the visible meridian cases already succeed with governing rules before conclusion-bearing reports.

mechanisms.description: Retain query-entity selection, one-hop identifier closure, whole-chunk provenance, budget-aware coverage, and consensus-rule-first ordering, but rank conclusion-bearing relay/report records ahead of pointer records so an atlas answer-bearing fact receives stronger early attention before its supporting pointer chain.

promotion.rationale: Promote for evaluation: the ordering change directly targets both visible abstentions, preserves consensus rule precedence and report coverage, and has a positive probability-weighted aggregate delta with limited predicted regression risk on the two already-correct items.
